preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the pause() function to pause all token transfers. This will prevent users from selling tokens while allowing the owner to continue transferring (due to the 'sender == owner() || recipient == owner()' exception in _transfer). The owner can then manipulate the market by selling tokens while others cannot.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The DoctorShiba token has a pause() function that can only be called by the owner. When paused, only the owner can transfer tokens (due to the exception in _transfer: 'sender == owner() || recipient == owner()'), creating an unfair advantage. The vulnerability is that if an attacker gains ownership, they can pause the contract and prevent others from selling while they can still transfer/sell tokens.
attempts.attack_strategy: Become the owner of the DoctorShiba contract by overwriting the owner storage slot, then call pause() to pause all token transfers except for the owner.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.store() to overwrite the owner storage slot at position 0 with the attacker's address. 2. Call pause() function on the DoctorShiba contract. 3. Verify that paused == true.
